National Service Scheme (NSS) Officers राष्ट्रीय सेवा योजना (NSS) पदाधिकारी

29 October 2026

As directed by Jai Prakash University, Chapra, the following assistant professors are authorised as unit-wise National Service Scheme (NSS) Officers of Government Degree College, Lahladpur (Saran) until further orders: 1. Ms. Nidhi Kumari (Department of English), Unit 1; 2. Dr. Sonam Kumari (Department of Hindi), Unit 2; 3. Dr. Shikha Singh (Department of Hindi), Unit 3. The responsibility takes effect from 29 October 2026. Ref. No. 70 RDM Lah/26, by order of the Principal.

जय प्रकाश विश्वविद्यालय, छपरा के निर्देशानुसार राजकीय डिग्री महाविद्यालय, लहलादपुर (सारण) में राष्ट्रीय सेवा योजना (NSS) के लिए निम्नलिखित सहायक प्राध्यापकों को अगले आदेश तक इकाईवार NSS पदाधिकारी अधिकृत किया जाता है: 1. सुश्री निधि कुमारी (अंग्रेज़ी विभाग), इकाई-1; 2. डॉ. सोनम कुमारी (हिंदी विभाग), इकाई-2; 3. डॉ. शिखा सिंह (हिंदी विभाग), इकाई-3। यह जिम्मेदारी आज की तिथि (29 अक्टूबर 2026) से प्रभावी होगी। पत्रांक 70 RDM Lah/26, प्राचार्य के आदेशानुसार।

Vidyarthi Sahyog Shivir विद्यार्थी सहयोग शिविर

22 September 2026

On 22 September 2026, a Vidyarthi Sahyog Shivir (student support camp) was held at the college at 11:30 AM, presided over by Principal Dr. Ramanuj Singh. A total of 112 students took part and put their concerns about their studies and basic facilities before the Principal, in writing and in person. The Principal guided the students, encouraged them to study regularly, and announced that their problems would be resolved within one month.

दिनांक 22 सितंबर 2026 (मंगलवार) को पूर्वाह्न 11:30 बजे प्राचार्य डॉ. रामानुज सिंह की अध्यक्षता में महाविद्यालय में विद्यार्थी सहयोग शिविर का आयोजन किया गया। शिविर में कुल 112 छात्र-छात्राओं ने भाग लिया और अपनी शैक्षणिक एवं मूलभूत सुविधाओं से संबंधित समस्याएँ लिखित एवं मौखिक रूप से प्राचार्य के समक्ष रखीं। प्राचार्य महोदय ने विद्यार्थियों का मार्गदर्शन करते हुए उन्हें नियमित अध्ययन के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया तथा एक माह के भीतर समस्याओं के समाधान की घोषणा की।

Inauguration of the college महाविद्यालय का उद्घाटन

15 July 2026

The inauguration ceremony of Government Degree College, Lahladpur (Saran) was held on 15 July 2026, presided over by Principal Dr. Ramanuj Singh. The Hon'ble Member of Parliament from Maharajganj, Shri Janardan Singh Sigriwal, and the Ekma MLA, Shri Manoranjan Singh (alias Dhumal Singh), inaugurated the college by lighting the lamp in the presence of the Principal. The Circle Officer of Lahladpur, the Welfare Officer of Chhapra and other dignitaries attended the ceremony.

राजकीय डिग्री महाविद्यालय, लहलादपुर (सारण) का उद्घाटन समारोह प्राचार्य डॉ. रामानुज सिंह की अध्यक्षता में दिनांक 15 जुलाई 2026 को आयोजित किया गया। माननीय महाराजगंज सांसद श्री जनार्दन सिंह सिग्रीवाल एवं एकमा विधायक श्री मनोरंजन सिंह (उर्फ़ धूमल सिंह) ने प्राचार्य की उपस्थिति में दीप प्रज्वलित कर महाविद्यालय का उद्घाटन किया। समारोह में अंचलाधिकारी, लहलादपुर, कल्याण पदाधिकारी, छपरा एवं अन्य गणमान्य लोग उपस्थित थे।

  • Lighting of the lamp at the inauguration
  • Welcoming the guests
  • Audience at the ceremony

Welcome to Government Degree College, Lahladpur

राजकीय डिग्री महाविद्यालय, लहलादपुर में आपका स्वागत है

The college is the first government degree college of Lahladpur block in Saran district. It was established on 1 June 2026 as one of 211 new government degree colleges set up by the Government of Bihar in blocks that had no degree college of their own.

As a constituent unit of Jai Prakash University, Chapra, the college teaches the Bachelor of Arts programme in six subjects, so that the young people of Lahladpur can complete their graduation close to home.

About the College महाविद्यालय परिचय

Government Degree College, Lahladpur, officially Rajkiya Degree Mahavidyalaya, Lahladpur, was established on 1 June 2026. It is one of 211 new government degree colleges set up by the Government of Bihar, one in each block that did not have a degree college before.

Most of Bihar's older colleges are in district towns, and many students from villages, especially girls, could not travel that far every day. A college in the block itself removes that barrier.

The college is a constituent unit of Jai Prakash University, Chapra. The university conducts admissions and examinations and awards the degree. The college runs the classes, guides students and keeps their records.

Vision

To make good higher education available to every young person of Lahladpur block.

Mission

  • To teach every student with care, in a language they understand.
  • To encourage daughters of the area to complete their graduation.
  • To prepare students for further study, competitive examinations and work.

Principal's Message प्राचार्य का संदेश

Dear students and parents,

Until this year, a young person in Lahladpur who wanted a degree had to travel far for it. Many could not, and our daughters were usually the first to give up. This college has been opened so that distance no longer decides who gets to study.

We teach six subjects in the Bachelor of Arts programme. Our teachers are qualified, and they are here for every student who comes through our gate, whatever school or village that student comes from.

I request parents to send their children to college, and I request students to attend classes regularly, ask questions freely and make full use of what the college offers. A degree earned with regular study opens the door to further education, competitive examinations and good work.

Our doors are open. You are welcome to visit the college.

Dr. Ramanuj SinghFounder Principal, Government Degree College, Lahladpur

Departments विभाग

The college offers the Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) programme in the following six subjects.

इतिहास

History

The history of India and the world, from ancient civilisations through the medieval period to modern times.

Faculty: Dr. Priyaranjan Singh, Dr. Harsh Ranjan Singh

हिंदी

Hindi

Hindi poetry, prose and drama, the history of Hindi literature, and the grammar and growth of the language.

Faculty: Dr. Sonam Kumari, Dr. Shikha Singh

समाजशास्त्र

Sociology

Family, caste, village, religion and social change, studied through the ideas of Indian and Western thinkers.

Faculty: Shivam Kumar

राजनीति विज्ञान

Political Science

The Indian Constitution, how governments work, political thinkers, and India's place in world politics.

Faculty: Dr. Shashi Kant Yadav

अंग्रेज़ी

English

English literature, from poetry to the novel, along with reading, writing and communication skills.

Faculty: Nidhi Kumari

अर्थशास्त्र

Economics

How economies work: markets, money, agriculture, development and the Indian economy.

Faculty: Dr. Preety Kumari

The syllabus, credits and examinations follow the regulations of Jai Prakash University, Chapra.

Admission नामांकन

Admission to the college is done through the online admission process of Jai Prakash University, Chapra.

Eligibility: students who have passed Intermediate (10+2) from a recognised board can apply. Seats and reservation follow the rules of Jai Prakash University and the Government of Bihar.

How to take admission

  1. Check the admission noticeThe university publishes the admission schedule on jpv.ac.in.
  2. Apply onlineFill the form on the JPU admission portal, jpvadm.samarth.edu.in. Choose Government Degree College, Lahladpur and your subject.
  3. Check the merit listThe university releases merit lists on the portal. Note your rank and the reporting dates.
  4. Report to the collegeBring your original documents for verification and complete the admission by paying the fee.

Documents required

  • Matric and Intermediate marksheets and certificates
  • School or College Leaving Certificate
  • Migration certificate, if you passed from a board outside Bihar
  • Caste, residential and income certificates, if claiming reservation
  • Aadhaar card
  • Recent passport-size photographs
Open admission portal

Please confirm the current dates with the college office before you travel. Phone: 99553 38362
